verified_facts.text: Cala Beach Resort has an original pyramid-like design.
verified_facts.excerpt: With its original pyramid-like design, Cala Beach Resort is a new luxury hotel in Tuscany at Punta Ala, Maremma.

verified_facts.text: The resort sits between the pinewood and the beach, close to the marina.
verified_facts.excerpt: It revels in a stunning position between the pinewood and the beach, close to the elegant marina.

verified_facts.text: Cala Beach, right in front of the resort, has 12 cabana areas for guests' exclusive use.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cala Beach right in front has 12 cabana areas for guests’ exclusive use.

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites offer views of the isle of Elba, with Corsica and Capraia in the distance.
verified_facts.excerpt: the rooms and suites offer prime views of the isle of Elba with Corsica and Capraia in the distance.

verified_facts.text: The Pyramid Junior Suite sits on top of the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: This luxuriously appointed residence revels in a striking location on top of the Cala Beach Resort.

verified_facts.text: The Panoramic Suites have their own independent entrance and a private terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: With their own independent entrance and elegantly furnished private terrace, these panoramic suites are a genuine haven of luxury.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have full-height windows that join the indoor and outdoor spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: The generous full-height windows unite the indoor and outdoor spaces in a seamless interplay between architecture and nature.

verified_facts.text: Rooms come with independent access to the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: With all the comforts you could wish for and your own independent access to the beach

verified_facts.text: VistAmare restaurant is set directly on the beach and serves contemporary Mediterranean cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: At “VistAmare” Restaurant, set directly on the golden beach of Punta Ala, you will enjoy contemporary Mediterranean cuisine that enhances premium, seasonal ingredients.

verified_facts.text: La Spiaggia restaurant is on the resort's private beach and serves Mediterranean-based fusion cuisine with international influences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the private beach of Cala Beach Resort, La Spiaggia Restaurant invites you to experience the sea in an authentic and relaxed way. Here, Mediterranean-based fusion cuisine meets international influences

verified_facts.text: La Vela restaurant is inside the La Vela beach club, on a terrace overlooking the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located within the homonymous beach club, La Vela Restaurant Punta Ala is where guests rediscover the authenticity of Mediterranean cuisine, in one of the most scenic terraces along the coast.

verified_facts.text: The resort has two bars serving cocktails and aperitifs on the sand.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two elegant bars complete the experience, offering cocktails and aperitifs on the sand.

verified_facts.text: There is a beauty center in La Spiaggia Beach Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: The beauty center in La Spiaggia Beach Club is your haven of relaxation, an intimate oasis for the senses.

verified_facts.text: The gym at La Vela beach is nearby and free for resort guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Cala Beach Resort’s nearby gym at La Vela beach is an opportunity not to miss. Featuring all the most innovative equipment, the facility offers free entry to resort guests.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join bike tours with specialist cycle-tourism guides.
verified_facts.excerpt: you’ll find an array of routes to suit your abilities and needs, aided by our specialist cycle-tourism guides.

verified_facts.text: Guests can join cooking classes with the chefs at VistAmare on traditional Maremma cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join a cookery class with our expert chefs at the VistAmare and discover the stories, secrets and authentic flavours of traditional Maremma cuisine.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers a romantic candlelit dinner on the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the beach of Punta Ala, a beautifully set table just steps from the sea, the gentle sound of the waves and the glow of candlelight create the perfect setting

verified_facts.text: Bolgheri is about an hour's drive from Punta Ala.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just an hour’s drive from Punta Ala, Bolgheri is a charming Tuscan village known for its iconic Viale dei Cipressi

verified_facts.text: Golf is available at Punta Ala Golf Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: an exciting round or two at **Punta Ala Golf Club**

verified_facts.text: The resort's address is Via della Dogana 4, Punta Ala, Grosseto, Italy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Via della Dogana 4 58043 Punta Ala Grosseto – Italy
